title: 第23章 共须山脉第24章 夜入山脉
content_zh:
听着女生撵人的语气，陆安虽然微微皱眉，但也没说什么。转身看向高大山几人，发现他们的脸色也不好看，便说道，“走吧，去外面看看。”
高大山看着那漂亮女孩，趁着对方低头的是时候瞪了一眼，才气呼呼的和陆安走掉。
陆安在猎手联盟里环视一圈，发现的确有几拨人各自形成一个圈子交谈，看来每一拨人就是一个队伍。看了一圈后，陆安注意到一拨人。
那拨人和其他圈子的人不同，其他的圈子都是以一个男人为中心在讨论，而这个圈子却以一名女生为中心。
那名女生看起来十九岁左右，穿着火辣性感，胸前露出深深的事业线，裙子侧面的岔口一直来到大腿根部，稍微一动便露出整条长腿，让人想入非非。
这个女生的很开朗，甚至可以说有些脾气暴躁。仅仅一分钟，陆安就发现这个女人打了其他人两下脑袋。虽然只是开玩笑，但也显示了这个人大姐大的性格。
其他人也环视一圈，看着众多的人都不敢上前说话，高大山忍不住对陆安问道，“我们去哪个？”
“就去那。”陆安看着前方，说道。
高大山闻言顺着陆安的视线看过去，紧接着也发现了那身材高挑火辣的女人，忍不住眼前一亮，说道，“你眼光很好啊！”
陆安无奈白了高大山一眼，说道，“此人虽然看起来风风火火的，但应该是个好说话的人。其他那些人都趾高气昂根本不愿意和同伴说话，只有这个有机会。”
说着，陆安对身后的众人说道，“不用太多人去，就大山哥和我去就够了，你们在这等一会。”
李东石等人闻言连忙点头，他们本来就有些怕和自卑，根本不太敢上前说话。
陆安和高大山两人朝着那群人走去，来到众人身后时并没有人发现他们两个。陆安见状轻咳了两声，礼貌问道，“请问，我们可以加入你们的团队吗？”
此言一出，顿时所有人一下子安静下来，纷纷转头看向面前的两人。
只见一个人高马大，一个看起来年纪很小，众人打量着这两人，眼神中都有些好奇。
果然，不出陆安所料，那个女人往前走了两步，周围的人也给她让出一条道路。女人仔细打量了两人，又看向远处一直盯着这边看的一群人，开口，冷漠问道，“你们是新生？”
“是。”陆安点了点头，说道，“昨天刚刚入学，我们想加入您的团队打下手，赚一点小钱。”
“赚钱？”女人看着面前这个比自己还矮一点的陆安，她看得出来对方只有十二三岁左右，不由得冷笑说道，“我的队伍人已经够了，为什么还要把钱分给你们这些人？”
说着，女人转头看着远处李东石等人，说道，“等到了山脉里，你们不仅帮不了忙，我还要分心保护你们，怎么想都是个赔钱的买卖。”
陆安听着女人的话，一点也没有生气，看着女人平静说道，“总会有能用到人的地方，我们也不为了赚很多钱，只是想混一口饭吃。”

两人四目相对，女人看着眼前穿着粗布衣裳的少年，她又岂会不知这些人都是穷人家的孩子？
“这里这么多人，你都问过了？”女人挑眉问道。
“没有。”陆安摇头，如实说道，“其他人没必要问，因为一定不会答应。”
“哦？”女人一笑，看着陆安的眼神多了点兴趣，问道，“那你怎么认为我会答应？你会看人？”
陆安闻言，没有回答。
他的确会看人，因为这是活着的基本能力。他给别人当奴隶的时候，有很多人到被处死的时候都不知道自己哪里惹到主人生气。能揣摩别人的心思，知道对方的性格和心里所想，才是关键。
看着沉默的陆安，女人兴趣更大了，因为她本来想无论这少年说什么，她都给打压回去。却没想到这少年什么也没说，倒是让她措手不及。
content_en:
Listening to the girl's flirtatious tone, Lu An frowned slightly but didn't say anything. He turned around and looked at the people in Gao Dashan, and found that their faces were not good-looking either, so he said, "Let's go and take a look outside."
Gao Dashan looked at the beautiful girl, glared at her when she lowered her head, and then walked away angrily with Lu An.
Lu An looked around the Hunter Alliance and found that there were indeed several groups of people talking in a circle. It seemed that each group of people formed a team. After looking around, Lu An noticed a group of people.
That group was different from people in other circles. Other circles centered their discussions around a man, but this circle centered around a girl.
The girl looked about nineteen years old. She was dressed in hot and sexy clothes, with a deep career line exposed on her chest. The slit on the side of her skirt reached to the root of her thighs, and her entire long legs were exposed with a slight movement, which made people think wildly.
This girl is very cheerful, even a bit grumpy. In just one minute, Lu An discovered that this woman had hit the other person twice on the head. Although it was just a joke, it also showed the character of this person's big sister.
Others also looked around, seeing that many people did not dare to come forward to speak. Gao Dashan couldn't help but ask Lu An, "Where should we go?"
"Just go there." Lu An looked ahead and said.
Hearing this, Gao Dashan followed Lu An's gaze and immediately spotted the tall and hot woman. He couldn't help but his eyes lit up and he said, "You have good taste!"
Lu An helplessly rolled his eyes at Gao Dashan and said, "Although this person looks hot-tempered, he should be a good talker. The other people are all arrogant and unwilling to talk to their companions. Only this one has a chance."
With that said, Lu An said to the people behind him, "You don't need too many people to go. It's enough for Brother Dashan and me to go. You guys wait here for a while."
Li Dongshi and others nodded quickly when they heard this. They were a little afraid and inferior, and they didn't dare to come forward and speak at all.
Lu An and Gao Dashan walked towards the group of people, and no one noticed them when they came behind them. Seeing this, Lu An coughed twice and asked politely, "Excuse me, can we join your team?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone suddenly became quiet and turned to look at the two people in front of them.
One person was tall and tall, and the other looked very young. Everyone looked at these two people with curiosity in their eyes.
Sure enough, as Lu An expected, the woman took two steps forward, and the people around her also made way for her. The woman looked at the two of them carefully, then looked at the group of people who had been staring in the distance, and asked coldly, "Are you freshmen?"
"Yes." Lu An nodded and said, "We just entered school yesterday. We want to join your team and make a little money."
"Making money?" The woman looked at Lu An, who was a little shorter than herself. She could see that he was only about twelve or thirteen years old, and couldn't help but sneer and said, "I already have enough people in my team, why should I give the money to you people?"
As she said that, the woman turned to look at Li Dongshi and others in the distance, and said, "When we get to the mountains, not only will you not be able to help, but I will have to distract myself from protecting you. No matter how you think about it, it will be a losing business."
Lu An listened to the woman's words and was not angry at all. He looked at the woman and said calmly, "There will always be places where people can be used. We don't do it to make a lot of money, we just want to make a living."
The two looked at each other, and the woman looked at the young man wearing coarse clothes in front of her. How could she not know that these people were children from poor families?
"There are so many people here, have you asked them all?" the woman asked, raising her eyebrows.
"No." Lu An shook his head and said truthfully, "There is no need for others to ask, because they will definitely not agree."
"Oh?" The woman smiled, looked at Lu An with more interest, and asked, "Then how do you recognizeWhy would I agree? Can you read people? "
Hearing this, Lu An did not answer.
He can indeed see people, because this is the basic ability of life. When he worked as a slave for others, many people did not know what made their master angry when they were executed. Being able to figure out other people's thoughts and know their personality and inner thoughts is the key.
Looking at the silent Lu An, the woman became more interested because she originally wanted to suppress whatever the young man said. But she didn't expect that the young man didn't say anything, which caught her off guard.
